note: State park on the Missouri River bluffs north of Ponca, on the Missouri National Recreational River. Turkey Ridge and Oak Bluff are wooded loops on the bluff top, well back from the river; Riverfront Campground is a separate open grassy loop on the river flat at the foot of the bluff, its outer road running along the brushy bank. Modern restrooms April-October; primitive camping year-round. Park entry permit required. --Claude
summary: ReserveAmerica confirms three RV loops (Turkey Ridge 35, Oak Bluff 37, Riverfront 20), 30/50 A electric, 40-60 ft sites with a few pull-throughs, showers, flush toilets and a dump, 180-day booking with most of Turkey Ridge first come; written. Fees re-based to the electric rates ($25 electric / $30 electric plus, quoted for 2027); every RV site has electric. Riverfront Campground sits on the river flat ~0.85 km from the bluff-top loops with its own road and a river view across its loop road: a split candidate, and the reason the stored 'not waterfront' is low for the park as a whole. The stored pin is ~1.9 km away at the education center.
